text:
sam: FYI I scheduled a short vendor lock meeting tomorrow 11am PT to finalize embargo windows and SI onramp for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi. Main asks: press slots, hidden prelists, and contingency routing.

leah: Marketplace ops here  we can support hidden prelists for SI with ACLs, but public flip must have `signed_driver_checksum` + `driver_signoff`. We'll also need SKU metadata for Dedicated quotas (min_commit_days).

tomas: Infra note  vendors gave ranges (Nvidia ~end-Mar, AMD MI300 mid-Apr, Gaudi early-Apr). We'll publish nightly canaries and attach CI smoke badges. GA still TBD.

ash: SI lead  need 48-72h between dry-run cycles. Gaudi racks limited Apr 10-14. Can we reserve slots and run two cycles back-to-back? Also need sample workloads + perf targets.

sam: Thinking of a 3-wave approach to minimize press collision:
- Wave 1: Partner+SI hidden preview -> H100 (canary), Gaudi preview
- Wave 2: Marketplace publish (hidden->public) -> MI300, B200 once `driver_signoff`
- Wave 3: Public press/blog -> H200 with partner quotes

leah: Need to standardize gating fields in SKU metadata: `prelist_visibility`, `prelist_acl`, `driver_signoff`, `signed_driver_checksum`, `quote_review_complete`. We'll add `quote_review_window` per vendor (default 72h).

tomas: Ops routing snippet we'll test in staging:
```
routing_policy:
  primary: H200
  fallback: [H100, B200]
  grace_days: 14
```
This will auto-route if H200 health drops or driver signoff delayed.

ash: SI checklist highlights: smoke test suite, p95 latency target, batching stability, KV cache persistence after restart, checkpoint restore. I'll post the matrix.

sam: One special ask from partners: Nvidia requested a 48h quote review for co-marketing; AMD wants logo approval process. We'll add vendor exceptions to opt-in sheet.

leah: Marketplace constraint  no public listing flips on Fridays (press heavy) and avoid major holiday windows. Recommend Tue/Wed publishes.

tomas: Also flagging H200 thermal derate note from HW team  if early silicon shows derate, we may hold public and run extended canary on H100/B200 variants. Add `thermal_derate_watch` to runbook.

sam: Action owners:
- Tomas: publish nightly canaries + signed checksums, add `thermal_derate_watch` flag
- Leah: SKU metadata + prelist ACL + pricing min_commit_days
- Ash: SI signup sheet + smoke test matrix + lab reservations
- Sam: draft embargo runbook + vendor opt-in doc and schedule vendor dry-run

partner-bot: Calendar invite: "HW vendor lock + dry-run" Tomorrow 11:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1715554321-hw-lock :white_check_mark:

leah: I'll prepare a minimal pricing field for Dedicated SKUs (`min_commit_days=30`) and attach to prelist drafts.

ash: Reserving Gaudi slots Apr 11 & Apr 13 for SI dry-runs. Please claim within 48h.

sam: Thanks all. If any vendor date or embargo exception appears, bump this thread and we'll slide the waves. :rocket:
